barrier_free_facilities_dataspec.pdf.extracted_text:
Barrier Free Access in MTR stations (English / Traditional Chinese)


Field Name                                           Data Type              Description
Station_No                                           String                 Station ID. Please refer to "Station ID" in mtr_lines_and_stations.csv
Key                                                  String                 Barrier-free facility ID. Please refer to "Item_Code" in
                                                                            barrier_free_facility_category.csv
Value                                                String                 Y/N. Y - Available in station; N - not available in station
AJTextEn                                             String                 Location(Exit) of the facility (English)
AJTextZh                                             String                 Location(Exit) of the facility (Chinese)
Exit_Coordinate_X_Y                                  String                 Longitude and Latitude of the Exit (not in use)

File Name: barrier_free_facilities.csv
File Format: CSV
Delimiter: Comma
Encoding: UTF-8
Note1: You may require to convert character codes, according to Hong Kong Supplementary Character Set, e.g. &#37032(邨)
Note2: The current dataset only contains static information about the provision of such facility at particular station and would not keep track
whether the facility is in service condition or under maintenance.
